smyx-neonatal-jaundice-screening-analysis 1.0.0 – Initial public release

- Enables AI-driven pre-screening of neonatal jaundice by analyzing high-resolution facial images to assess sclera and skin yellowness.
- Automatically outputs jaundice risk level (low / medium / high / inconclusive) with parental and medical action suggestions.
- Supports daily scheduled or on-demand analysis, image quality checks, and reminder notifications for medium or high risk.
- Allows querying and viewing of structured historical screening reports via cloud API, with strict open-id/user authentication requirements.
- Designed for integration with smart baby monitors or maternal/infant apps, and applicable in both home and healthcare settings.
- Bilingual instructions and workflows provided (English/Chinese) for diverse user needs.
